suggestedMessage: Hey Antanas, no worries at all! What I sent over was a design concept for a new investor facing homepage for Gravity Fellow. It is not live anywhere, just a prototype for you to look at and see if it fits how you want to present the business to investors. You can open the folder I shared earlier and click through the demo inside it. Let me know what you think once you have had a look!

Hey Sholi, thanks for the nudge, I have not had the chance to properly look into ESRE yet but it is now on my list. In the meantime, is there anything on the Sense Future side where my agency could help, like building out tools or a website for it? Happy to take a look whenever it is useful for you.

Hi Happy, that is a real challenge many founders face early on. I do not have a strong background in raising seed funding myself, so I cannot speak to that with much authority. Happy to think out loud with you about it though, and would love to hear more about where Brillio Africa is at and what support would help most right now.

Hi Johannes, market entry into NL is not something my agency directly handles ourselves, our focus is on building the tools and websites side of things, like the partner portal concept I mentioned earlier. That said, I am happy to make an introduction if I come across the right connections for the NL side. In the meantime, would it still be useful for me to send over the portal sketch we put together?
Hi Joel, perfect, thank you for sending that over. I will grab a slot on your calendar and confirm from there. Looking forward to it!

Hey Timur, likewise! I had a look at LeBretons Group, digital transformation and strategy consultancy is a space with a lot happening right now. Would love to hear more about what a typical client engagement looks like for you, and see if there is a way my agency could support the tools or website side of that.
Hey Erisan, likewise, glad we connected! Would love to hear more about what you are building at Revios when you have a moment.

Thanks for the update Horst, sounds like a big milestone coming up with the licence. I will keep an eye out and check back in closer to when the licence comes through, good luck getting everything ready for production.

Hey Peter, happy to connect with a fellow founder too! Impact Applications sounds like a genuinely useful service, taking the grant admin off founders' plates. Would love to hear more about how you are finding new clients right now.
Hey Saeid, thanks for connecting! FlowVolta sounds like exciting work in the hydrogen space. Would love to hear more about where you are at with the technology and go to market side of things.
Great to connect with you too Arindam! Would love to hear more about what you are building at The Job Workshop.

Hey Joanna, likewise, thanks for being open to sharing ideas! I had a look at BrightByDesign, helping families build stronger routines through those neurological and psychological principles sounds like meaningful work. Would love to hear more about where you are focused right now.
Great to connect Aashir! Sounds like you have a lot going on between Oranjelo and the startup advisory side. Would love to hear more about what you are focused on building right now.

Hey Amina, likewise, would love to connect too! I had a look at Autimly, building one place for people to navigate an autism or ADHD diagnosis feels like a genuinely needed platform. Would love to hear more about how it is going so far.

Thanks for the intro Basile, glad to connect! Expansion Partners sounds like an interesting angle on biomass and climate tech investment. I will take a look at The Biomass Insider, appreciate you sharing it.

Hey Kenfack, sorry for the confusion, that message was a generic follow up and did not mean a specific one of your businesses! I was referring to procedo, just curious how things are going there and whether there is anything on the website or tooling side my agency could help with.

Hey Griet, that is exciting, wishing you a lot of luck on the entrepreneurial journey! I had a look at Studio GROA, the storytelling and game design angle is a really unique mix. Would love to hear more about what you are working on right now.
Hi Aart, sounds good, no rush on my end. I will check back in around September once your new marcom colleague has started, feel free to loop me in whenever it works for you.
Hey Stefan, just floating this back up in case it got buried, no pressure either way. Let me know if it would be useful to see the sketch, or if now is not the right time.
